players.product: high-layer-count and high-order HDI PCBs for AI servers / GPU boards, plus mSAP 800G / 1.6T optical-module PCBs

quarterly_data.signal: Director and president Liu Yu and chairman Liu Shaobai (2025 annual results briefing): the new high-order HDI plant at the Zhuhai Jinwan base is planned to start trial production in mid-2026, and the Thailand production base is expected to start production within 2026; some upgraded Zhuhai Jinwan lines already went into production in 2025, and the Zhuhai Jinwan expansion is progressing relatively fast. Zhuhai Jinwan has any-layer mass-production capability and the mSAP process and can make SLP products, which serve high-end consumer electronics, memory chips / modules and data centers. The chairman said recent capacity expansion focuses on high-order HDI, ultra-high-layer and SLP products for AI-compute data centers, with some expansion of other product types. On 2025 margins he said high, volatile upstream raw-material prices, strategic investment and the ramp of new plants pressured gross margin, and named product-mix upgrades, deeper customer cooperation and overseas expansion as the levers for mid-to-long-term profitability; the president said the company will strengthen its lead as what it calls the world's largest automotive PCB supplier while building the AI data-infrastructure business as a new growth driver.
quarterly_data.figure: new Zhuhai Jinwan high-order HDI plant trial production mid-2026; Thailand base production within 2026
